result.summary: The home screen mostly renders correctly. The clearest defect is the profile/avatar button in the top-right, which is an empty grey circle with only a red notification dot. There is also a minor inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between the two Popular cards.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right header is an empty grey circle. It shows no avatar image, initials or icon, only a red notification dot. The image or icon appears to have failed to load, so users can't tell what the button does.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the avatar image loads. If it doesn't, fall back to the user's initials or a generic profile or bell icon. Also give the button an accessible label.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) buttons on the Popular cards look different. On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the button's dark circle blends into the dark image. On the pizza card below, the same button has a clearly visible dark circle behind it.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent background for the heart button, such as a semi-transparent dark or white circle with enough contrast, so it stays visible on any image.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card says '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery information in one place, or use the badge for a different promotional message.
